construct: 5 sibling options where ONE is HIGHLIGHTED (active descendant) by a single-SIDE border - `border-left: 3px solid rgb(37, 99, 235)` against a transparent left border on the other four
why: Highlighted and selected are different states of the same list and a combobox needs both at once, so they are two cases rather than one. This one is carried by a PER-SIDE border, the accent bar every listbox uses for keyboard focus: the four quiet siblings reserve the same 3px so nothing shifts when the highlight moves, which means the construct is entirely a border COLOUR difference on one edge. A per-side border that collapses to a uniform stroke takes the direction of the highlight with it.
